title: 9000 WEST HOPEN PLACE & 1481 NORTH BLUE JAY WAY; BOARD FILE NO. 250902
text:
[D. PUBLIC HEARINGS regarding EXPORT-IMPORT applications pursuant to Section 91.7006.7.5]
9000 WEST HOPEN PLACE & 1481 NORTH BLUE JAY WAY; BOARD FILE NO. 250902
  C.D.: 4 (Councilmember Nithya Raman); Hollywood Planning Area
  **(Continued from October 20, 2026 Hearing)**

  STAFF MEMBER:  Joaquin Greenough
  BUREAU/DIVISION:  Inspection/Grading

  APPLICANT:  Jimmy Toetz

  Consideration of Application to export 3,619.2 cubic yards of earth from the project site; and
  consideration whether the project is categorically exempt under CEQA pursuant to Sections 15301
  (Class 1) and 15303 (Class 3) of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) Guidelines (Case
  No. ENV-2025-878-CE), and there is no substantial evidence demonstrating that an exception to a
  categorical exemption pursuant to CEQA Guidelines, Section 15300.2 applies.

  ACTION BY THE BBSC IS APPEALABLE TO THE CITY COUNCIL WITHIN TEN DAYS PURSUANT TO
  SECTION 91.7006.7.5.
